articles.summary: The Doctors Company, the nation’s largest physician-owned medical malpractice insurer, today released “Orthopedics Claims: October Malpractice Risk Review,” the newest edition in a monthly series of specialty-focused analyses designed to support patient safety and clinical risk management.
articles.title: Orthopedics Risk Review Launched

articles.summary: The Doctors Company is rated A+ by AM Best and A by Fitch Ratings.*
articles.title: AM Best Upgrades Financial Strength Ratings for The Doctors Company

articles.summary: AM Best has upgraded The Doctors Company’s financial strength rating (FSR) to A+ (Superior) from A (Excellent) and the long-term issuer credit rating (ICR) to “aa-” (Superior) from “a+” (Excellent). The outlook of these ratings is stable.
articles.title: AM Best Upgrades Financial Strength Ratings for The Doctors Company
